title: Correct charge formula
description: Essential: The student's response must correctly derive or state the formula q = NBS/(R+r) for the charge through the bulb in the given time interval.

title: Correct charge value
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) must be q = √2/2 C (or approximately 0.707 C).

title: Correct work formula
description: Essential: The student's response must correctly relate the external work W to the Joule heat over one period, using W = I²(R+r)T.

title: Correct work value
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (2) must be W = 50π J (or approximately 157.08 J).

title: Average EMF reasoning
description: Important: The solution must apply Faraday's law correctly for the average EMF over the 0 to T/4 interval, using the change in magnetic flux.

title: Angular speed calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly convert the rotational speed n to angular velocity ω using ω = 2πn.

title: RMS current derivation
description: Important: The solution must correctly derive the RMS current from the peak EMF for the sinusoidal AC, applying I = E_m / (√2(R+r)).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for sign errors in the EMF formula or incorrect unit handling (e.g., not converting rpm to rad/s correctly).

title: Resistance sum omission
description: Pitfall: Deduct points if the student uses only R or only r in the Ohm's law calculations, instead of the total resistance (R+r).

title: Alternative approach clarity
description: Optional: Award points for a clear alternative solution path, such as using calculus for charge or energy integration.
